## Population trends in Grafschaft Bentheim

This page presents the age structure and long-term population trends of the Grafschaft Bentheim district and its 25 municipalities.

For the long-term time series, historical population figures up to 1970 are combined with the annual population data available from the **LSN online portal** from 1973 onwards. From 1973 onwards, only the **total population** is used.

When hovering over a data point, or **tapping a data point on a mobile device**, the **average age of the population** is also shown whenever an original value is available in the LSN table for that year. For individual municipalities, selected indicators from **BBSR INKAR** are also included where data are available for the respective year.

```{r}
#| label: kennzahlen
#| include: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Kreiszeitreihe
# -------------------------------------------------

bevoelkerung_kreis <- read_csv2(
  "../data/bevoelkerung_grafschaft_1821_2026_mit_alter.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    jahr = col_integer(),
    bevoelkerung = col_double(),
    durchschnittsalter = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  transmute(
    year = jahr,
    population = bevoelkerung,
    durchschnittsalter = durchschnittsalter
  ) |>
  arrange(year)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Gemeindereihen
#
# Historische Werte bis 1970 +
# jährliche LSN-Werte 1973–2026
# -------------------------------------------------

bevoelkerung_gemeinden <- read_csv2(
  "../data/bevoelkerung_gemeinden_1821_2026_mit_alter.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    lsn_code = col_character(),
    ags_8 = col_character(),
    year = col_integer(),
    population = col_double(),
    durchschnittsalter = col_double(),
    .default = col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  arrange(
    region_name,
    year
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# BBSR-INKAR-Daten für die Gemeinden
#
# Datei: data/INKAR_BBSR.xlsx
# Tabellenblatt: Daten_lang
#
# Verwendete Indikatoren:
# - Frauenanteil
# - Einpersonenhaushalte
# - Einwohnerdichte
# -------------------------------------------------

inkar_lang <- read_excel(
  "../data/INKAR_BBSR.xlsx",
  sheet = "Daten_lang",
  col_types = c(
    "text",
    "text",
    "text",
    "numeric",
    "numeric"
  )
) |>
  transmute(
    ags_8 = Kennziffer,
    indikator = Indikator,
    year = as.integer(Jahr),
    wert = as.numeric(Wert)
  ) |>
  filter(
    nchar(ags_8) == 8,
    indikator %in% c(
      "Frauenanteil",
      "Einpersonenhaushalte",
      "Einwohnerdichte"
    )
  )


# Prüfen, ob jede Kombination aus Gemeinde, Jahr und Indikator eindeutig ist
stopifnot(
  nrow(inkar_lang) ==
    nrow(
      distinct(
        inkar_lang,
        ags_8,
        year,
        indikator
      )
    )
)


# Prüfen, ob alle 25 Gemeinden enthalten sind
stopifnot(
  n_distinct(inkar_lang$ags_8) == 25
)


# INKAR-Daten in breite Form bringen
inkar_gemeinden <- inkar_lang |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = indikator,
    values_from = wert
  ) |>
  rename(
    frauenanteil_inkar = Frauenanteil,
    einpersonenhaushalte_inkar = Einpersonenhaushalte,
    einwohnerdichte_inkar = Einwohnerdichte
  )


# INKAR-Indikatoren an die bestehende Gemeindereihe anhängen
bevoelkerung_gemeinden <- bevoelkerung_gemeinden |>
  left_join(
    inkar_gemeinden,
    by = c(
      "ags_8",
      "year"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    region_name,
    year
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Kennzahlen Landkreis
# -------------------------------------------------

kennzahlen_2022 <- bevoelkerung_kreis |>
  filter(
    year == 2022
  ) |>
  pull(
    population
  )

kennzahlen_2025 <- bevoelkerung_kreis |>
  filter(
    year == 2025
  ) |>
  pull(
    population
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Prozentuale Veränderung 2022–2025
# -------------------------------------------------

veraenderung_2022_2025 <-
  100 * (
    kennzahlen_2025 /
      kennzahlen_2022 - 1
  )


trend_text <- paste0(
  ifelse(
    veraenderung_2022_2025 > 0,
    "+",
    ""
  ),
  format(
    round(
      veraenderung_2022_2025,
      1
    ),
    decimal.mark = ".",
    nsmall = 1
  ),
  " %"
)


trend_farbe <- ifelse(
  veraenderung_2022_2025 > 0,
  "#2E7D32",
  ifelse(
    veraenderung_2022_2025 < 0,
    "#C62828",
    "#666666"
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Größte Gemeinde 2025
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_2025_tmp <- bevoelkerung_gemeinden |>
  filter(
    year == 2025
  )

groesste_gemeinde <- bev_2025_tmp[
  which.max(
    bev_2025_tmp$population
  ),
]
```

```{r}
#| label: altersstruktur-interaktiv
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Altersdaten einlesen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bev_alter_interaktiv <- read_csv2(
  "../data/bev_alter_sex.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    gebietscode = col_character(),
    gebiet = col_character(),
    gebietstyp = col_character(),
    geschlecht = col_character(),
    altersgruppe = col_character(),
    altersgruppen_typ = col_character(),
    alter_von = col_double(),
    alter_bis_unter = col_double(),
    jahr = col_integer(),
    anzahl = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(
    gebietstyp %in% c("Landkreis", "Gemeinde"),
    jahr %in% 2022:2025,
    altersgruppen_typ == "Detail",
    !is.na(alter_von)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    gebiet_display = ifelse(
      gebietstyp == "Landkreis",
      "Grafschaft Bentheim",
      sub(", Stadt$", "", gebiet)
    ),
    titel_gebiet = ifelse(
      gebietstyp == "Landkreis",
      "der Grafschaft Bentheim",
      gebiet_display
    ),
    altersgruppe_5j = ifelse(
      alter_von >= 85,
      "85+",
      paste0(
        floor(alter_von / 5) * 5,
        "-",
        floor(alter_von / 5) * 5 + 4
      )
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    gebiet_display,
    titel_gebiet,
    jahr,
    geschlecht,
    altersgruppe_5j
  ) |>
  summarise(
    anzahl = if (
      any(is.na(anzahl))
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(anzahl)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Einheitliche Reihenfolge der Altersgruppen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

altersreihenfolge_interaktiv <- c(
  "0-4",
  "5-9",
  "10-14",
  "15-19",
  "20-24",
  "25-29",
  "30-34",
  "35-39",
  "40-44",
  "45-49",
  "50-54",
  "55-59",
  "60-64",
  "65-69",
  "70-74",
  "75-79",
  "80-84",
  "85+"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Männer / Frauen nebeneinander stellen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bev_alter_plot <- bev_alter_interaktiv |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = geschlecht,
    values_from = anzahl
  ) |>
  rename(
    maenner = Männlich,
    frauen = Weiblich
  ) |>
  mutate(
    gesamt = ifelse(
      is.na(maenner) | is.na(frauen),
      NA_real_,
      maenner + frauen
    ),
    altersgruppe_5j = factor(
      altersgruppe_5j,
      levels = altersreihenfolge_interaktiv
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    gebiet_display,
    jahr,
    altersgruppe_5j
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Symmetrische Achsengrenze je Gebiet
# Sie bleibt über 2022-2025 gleich, damit die Jahre vergleichbar sind.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nice_axis_max <- function(x) {

  maximum <- max(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) * 1.08

  kandidaten <- c(
    50,
    100,
    200,
    400,
    500,
    800,
    1000,
    2000,
    4000,
    5000,
    8000,
    10000,
    20000
  )

  passend <- kandidaten[
    kandidaten >= maximum
  ]

  if (length(passend) > 0) {
    passend[1]
  } else {
    ceiling(maximum / 10000) * 10000
  }
}

achsen_grenzen <- bev_alter_plot |>
  group_by(
    gebiet_display
  ) |>
  summarise(
    achsen_max = nice_axis_max(
      c(
        maenner,
        frauen
      )
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bev_alter_plot <- bev_alter_plot |>
  left_join(
    achsen_grenzen,
    by = "gebiet_display"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Datenobjekt für die clientseitigen Filter
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bev_alter_split <- split(
  bev_alter_plot,
  paste(
    bev_alter_plot$gebiet_display,
    bev_alter_plot$jahr,
    sep = "|||"
  )
)

bev_alter_lookup <- lapply(
  bev_alter_split,
  function(d) {

    d <- d[
      order(
        d$altersgruppe_5j
      ),
    ]

    list(
      gebiet = d$gebiet_display[1],
      titel_gebiet = d$titel_gebiet[1],
      jahr = d$jahr[1],
      altersgruppe = as.character(
        d$altersgruppe_5j
      ),
      maenner = unname(
        d$maenner
      ),
      frauen = unname(
        d$frauen
      ),
      gesamt = unname(
        d$gesamt
      ),
      achsen_max = d$achsen_max[1]
    )
  }
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Startansicht: Grafschaft Bentheim, 2025
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pyramide_initial <- bev_alter_plot |>
  filter(
    gebiet_display == "Grafschaft Bentheim",
    jahr == 2025
  ) |>
  arrange(
    altersgruppe_5j
  )

format_anzahl_interaktiv <- function(x) {

  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "n/a",
    scales::number(
      x,
      accuracy = 1,
      big.mark = ",",
      decimal.mark = "."
    )
  )
}

hover_initial <- paste0(
  "<b>",
  as.character(
    pyramide_initial$altersgruppe_5j
  ),
  "</b>",
  "<br><br>",
  "Population (Male): ",
  format_anzahl_interaktiv(
    pyramide_initial$maenner
  ),
  "<br>",
  "Population (Female): ",
  format_anzahl_interaktiv(
    pyramide_initial$frauen
  ),
  "<br>",
  "Population (Total): ",
  format_anzahl_interaktiv(
    pyramide_initial$gesamt
  )
)

achsen_max_initial <- unique(
  pyramide_initial$achsen_max
)

x_ticks_initial <- c(
  -achsen_max_initial,
  -achsen_max_initial / 2,
  0,
  achsen_max_initial / 2,
  achsen_max_initial
)

x_ticktexte_initial <- c(
  scales::number(
    achsen_max_initial,
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    accuracy = 1
  ),
  scales::number(
    achsen_max_initial / 2,
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    accuracy = 1
  ),
  "-",
  scales::number(
    achsen_max_initial / 2,
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    accuracy = 1
  ),
  scales::number(
    achsen_max_initial,
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    accuracy = 1
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Bevölkerungspyramide
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_bev_alter <- plot_ly() |>

  add_bars(
    data = pyramide_initial,
    y = ~altersgruppe_5j,
    x = ~-maenner,
    orientation = "h",
    name = "Male",
    marker = list(
      color = "#073B70"
    ),
    width = 0.82,
    hovertext = hover_initial,
    hovertemplate = "%{hovertext}<extra></extra>"
  ) |>

  add_bars(
    data = pyramide_initial,
    y = ~altersgruppe_5j,
    x = ~frauen,
    orientation = "h",
    name = "Female",
    marker = list(
      color = "#D70A53"
    ),
    width = 0.82,
    hovertext = hover_initial,
    hovertemplate = "%{hovertext}<extra></extra>"
  ) |>

  layout(
    barmode = "overlay",
    bargap = 0.12,
    height = 540,
    showlegend = TRUE,
    hovermode = "closest",
    hoverdistance = 50,
    dragmode = FALSE,

    font = list(
      family = "Arial, sans-serif",
      color = "#222222"
    ),

    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0.5,
      y = 1.03,
      xanchor = "center",
      yanchor = "bottom",
      font = list(
        size = 16
      )
    ),

    xaxis = list(
      title = "",
      range = c(
        -achsen_max_initial,
        achsen_max_initial
      ),
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = x_ticks_initial,
      ticktext = x_ticktexte_initial,
      tickfont = list(
        size = 13,
        color = "#666666"
      ),
      showgrid = TRUE,
      gridcolor = "#D3D3D3",
      gridwidth = 1,
      zeroline = TRUE,
      zerolinecolor = "#1F1F1F",
      zerolinewidth = 1.4,
      showline = TRUE,
      linecolor = "#6F6F6F",
      linewidth = 1.25,
      ticks = "",
      automargin = TRUE,
      fixedrange = TRUE
    ),

    yaxis = list(
      title = "",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = altersreihenfolge_interaktiv,
      tickfont = list(
        size = 14,
        color = "#666666"
      ),
      showgrid = FALSE,
      showline = TRUE,
      linecolor = "#6F6F6F",
      linewidth = 1.25,
      automargin = TRUE,
      fixedrange = TRUE
    ),

    margin = list(
      l = 88,
      r = 28,
      t = 54,
      b = 32
    ),

    plot_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",
    paper_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",

    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#000000",
      bordercolor = "#000000",
      font = list(
        color = "#FFFFFF",
        size = 14
      ),
      align = "left"
    )
  ) |>

  config(
    displayModeBar = FALSE,
    responsive = TRUE,
    scrollZoom = FALSE,
    doubleClick = FALSE
  )


# Datensatz für JavaScript an das Widget anhängen
p_bev_alter$x$gizData <- bev_alter_lookup


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Filterlogik und Smartphone-Anpassungen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_bev_alter <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_bev_alter,
  "
  function(el, x) {

    var dataLookup = x.gizData || {};
    var gebietSelect = document.getElementById('bev-alter-gebiet');
    var jahrButtons = Array.prototype.slice.call(
      document.querySelectorAll('.bevoelkerung-alter-jahr')
    );
    var currentYear = 2025;

    if (!gebietSelect || jahrButtons.length === 0) {
      return;
    }


    function formatDE(value) {
      if (value === null || value === undefined || Number.isNaN(value)) {
        return 'n/a';
      }

      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-GB', {
        maximumFractionDigits: 0
      }).format(value);
    }


    function makeHover(d) {
      return d.altersgruppe.map(function(age, i) {
        return '<b>' + age + '</b>' +
          '<br><br>' +
          'Population (Male): ' + formatDE(d.maenner[i]) +
          '<br>' +
          'Population (Female): ' + formatDE(d.frauen[i]) +
          '<br>' +
          'Population (Total): ' + formatDE(d.gesamt[i]);
      });
    }


    function updatePyramid() {

      var gebiet = gebietSelect.value;
      var key = gebiet + '|||' + currentYear;
      var d = dataLookup[key];

      if (!d) {
        return;
      }

      var hover = makeHover(d);

      var maennerNegativ = d.maenner.map(function(v) {
        return v === null ? null : -v;
      });

      Plotly.restyle(
        el,
        {
          x: [maennerNegativ, d.frauen],
          y: [d.altersgruppe, d.altersgruppe],
          hovertext: [hover, hover]
        },
        [0, 1]
      );

      var max = d.achsen_max;
      var halb = max / 2;

      Plotly.relayout(
        el,
        {
          'xaxis.range': [-max, max],
          'xaxis.tickvals': [-max, -halb, 0, halb, max],
          'xaxis.ticktext': [
            formatDE(max),
            formatDE(halb),
            '-',
            formatDE(halb),
            formatDE(max)
          ]
        }
      );

    }


    gebietSelect.addEventListener(
      'change',
      updatePyramid
    );


    jahrButtons.forEach(function(button) {

      button.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function() {

          currentYear = Number(
            button.getAttribute('data-year')
          );

          jahrButtons.forEach(function(b) {
            b.classList.remove('is-active');
          });

          button.classList.add('is-active');

          updatePyramid();
        }
      );
    });


    function isMobile() {
      return window.innerWidth <= 600;
    }


    function responsivePyramid() {

      var mobile = isMobile();

      Plotly.relayout(
        el,
        {
          'height': mobile ? 500 : 540,
          'margin.l': mobile ? 58 : 88,
          'margin.r': mobile ? 8 : 28,
          'margin.t': mobile ? 46 : 54,
          'margin.b': mobile ? 34 : 32,
          'yaxis.tickfont.size': mobile ? 10.5 : 14,
          'xaxis.tickfont.size': mobile ? 9.5 : 13,
          'legend.font.size': mobile ? 12 : 16,
          'hoverlabel.font.size': mobile ? 11 : 14
        }
      );

      Plotly.Plots.resize(el);
    }


    el.on(
      'plotly_click',
      function(eventData) {

        if (
          !isMobile() ||
          !eventData.points ||
          !eventData.points.length
        ) {
          return;
        }

        var point = eventData.points[0];

        Plotly.Fx.hover(
          el,
          [
            {
              curveNumber: point.curveNumber,
              pointNumber: point.pointNumber
            }
          ]
        );
      }
    );


    responsivePyramid();

    window.addEventListener(
      'resize',
      responsivePyramid
    );
  }
  "
)


p_bev_alter
```

## Long-term population trend

The chart shows the population trend of the entire district from **1821 to 2026**. Individual historical values are available up to 1970; from 1973 onwards, an annual population series is available. Hover over a point or **tap it on a smartphone** to display the **year, population and – where available – average age**.

::: {.bevoelkerung-chart .bevoelkerung-chart-kreis}

```{r}
#| label: bevoelkerungsentwicklung
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(plotly)
library(scales)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Darstellung vorbereiten
# -------------------------------------------------

bevoelkerung_kreis_plot <- bevoelkerung_kreis |>
  mutate(

    population_label =
      scales::number(
        population,
        big.mark = ",",
        decimal.mark = ".",
        accuracy = 1
      ),

    durchschnittsalter_label =
      ifelse(
        is.na(durchschnittsalter),
        "",
        paste0(
          format(
            round(
              durchschnittsalter,
              1
            ),
            decimal.mark = ".",
            nsmall = 1
          ),
          " years"
        )
      ),

    hover_text =
      ifelse(
        is.na(durchschnittsalter),

        paste0(
          "<b>Grafschaft Bentheim</b>",
          "<br>Year: ",

          "<br>Population: ",

          "<b>Grafschaft Bentheim</b>",

          year,
          "<br>Population: ",
          population_label,

          durchschnittsalter_label
        )
      ),

    marker_size =
      ifelse(
        year < 1973,
        7,
        4.5
      )

y_breaks_kreis <- pretty(
```

<strong>Source:</strong> Population figures: historical series up to 1970; from 1973 onwards, Lower Saxony State Office for Statistics (LSN), table Z100001G, total population, reference date 30 June. Average age: LSN, table Z100004G, all sexes, reference date 31 December.
</div>

<div class="small text-muted" style="margin-top:0.25rem;">
<strong>Note:</strong> The subtle vertical lines mark the start of the annual LSN series in 1973 and important changes in the underlying statistical data. Long-term changes across these transitions should be interpreted with caution.
</div>


## Data basis

The long-term series extend back to **1821**. Historical population figures are used up to and including 1970. No values are available for 1971 and 1972 in the series used here, and no values are interpolated.

From **1973** onwards, the annually available **total population** figures from LSN online table Z100001G are used for the district and all 25 municipalities. The figures refer to the **reference date of 30 June** in each year.

Sex-specific figures, cadastral area and population density from the LSN population table are not used directly for the population time series. However, population density from **BBSR INKAR** is added as an additional indicator in the hover information for the interactive municipality chart.

The **average age** is taken from LSN online table Z100004G and refers to the total population as of **31 December** of each year. The supplied table contains values for **1970, 1975, 1980, 1985, 1990, 1995, 2000, 2005 and 2010**, followed by **annual values from 2011 to 2025**. No values are interpolated for the intervening years.

For the **25 municipalities**, three additional indicators from **BBSR INKAR** are included. They appear only in the hover information of the municipality chart and only when a value is available for the respective year:

- **Female share:** annually from 1995–2023
- **Population density:** 1996, 2000, 2004 and annually from 2008–2023
- **Single-person households:** annually from 2013–2023

The INKAR data are linked to the population series using the eight-digit official municipality code. Missing INKAR values are not interpolated.


## Trends in individual municipalities

Select a municipality to view its long-term population trend. Here too, the annually available LSN population figures are used from 1973 onwards. When hovering over a data point, or **tapping a data point on a mobile device**, the **average age**, **female share**, share of **single-person households** and **population density** are also shown where available for the respective year.

::: {.bevoelkerung-chart .bevoelkerung-chart-gemeinden}

```{r}
#| label: gemeinden-interaktiv
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(plotly)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Gemeinden alphabetisch sortieren
# -------------------------------------------------

gemeinden <- sort(
  unique(
    bevoelkerung_gemeinden$region_name
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Nordhorn als Startansicht
# -------------------------------------------------

default_index <- which(
  gemeinden == "Nordhorn"
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Plot aufbauen
# -------------------------------------------------

p <- plot_ly()


for (i in seq_along(gemeinden)) {

  g <- gemeinden[i]


  daten_gemeinde <- bevoelkerung_gemeinden |>

    filter(
      region_name == g
    ) |>

    arrange(year) |>

    mutate(

      population_label =
        scales::number(
          population,
          big.mark = ",",
          decimal.mark = ".",
          accuracy = 1
        ),

      durchschnittsalter_label =
        ifelse(
          is.na(durchschnittsalter),
          "",
          paste0(
            format(
              round(
                durchschnittsalter,
                1
              ),
              decimal.mark = ".",
              nsmall = 1,
              trim = TRUE
            ),
            " years"
          )
        ),

      frauenanteil_label =
        ifelse(
          is.na(frauenanteil_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            format(
              round(
                frauenanteil_inkar,
                2
              ),
              decimal.mark = ".",
              nsmall = 2,
              trim = TRUE
            ),
            " %"
          )
        ),

      einpersonenhaushalte_label =
        ifelse(
          is.na(einpersonenhaushalte_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            format(
              round(
                einpersonenhaushalte_inkar,
                2
              ),
              decimal.mark = ".",
              nsmall = 2,
              trim = TRUE
            ),
            " %"
          )
        ),

      einwohnerdichte_label =
        ifelse(
          is.na(einwohnerdichte_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            format(
              round(
                einwohnerdichte_inkar,
                2
              ),
              big.mark = ",",
              decimal.mark = ".",
              nsmall = 2,
              trim = TRUE
            ),
            " inhabitants/km²"
          )
        ),

      durchschnittsalter_hover =
        ifelse(
          is.na(durchschnittsalter),
          "",
          paste0(
            "<br>Average age (31 Dec): ",
            durchschnittsalter_label
          )
        ),

      frauenanteil_hover =
        ifelse(
          is.na(frauenanteil_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            "<br>Female share (INKAR): ",
            frauenanteil_label
          )
        ),

      einpersonenhaushalte_hover =
        ifelse(
          is.na(einpersonenhaushalte_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            "<br>Single-person households (INKAR): ",
            einpersonenhaushalte_label
          )
        ),

      einwohnerdichte_hover =
        ifelse(
          is.na(einwohnerdichte_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            "<br>Population density (INKAR): ",
            einwohnerdichte_label
          )
        ),

      hover_text =
        paste0(
          "<b>",
          g,
          "</b>",
          "<br>Year: ",
          year,
          "<br>Population: ",
          population_label,
          durchschnittsalter_hover,
          frauenanteil_hover,
          einpersonenhaushalte_hover,
          einwohnerdichte_hover
        ),

      marker_size =
        ifelse(
          year < 1973,
          7,
          4.5
        )
    )


  p <- p |>

    add_trace(

      data =
        daten_gemeinde,

      x =
        ~year,

      y =
        ~population,

      type =
        "scatter",

      mode =
        "lines+markers",

      name =
        g,

      visible =
        i == default_index,

      line = list(
        color = "#2E6B3E",
        width = 3
      ),

      marker = list(
        color = "#2E6B3E",
        size = daten_gemeinde$marker_size,
        opacity = 0.85
      ),

      text =
        ~hover_text,

      hovertemplate =
        "%{text}<extra></extra>"
    )
}


# -------------------------------------------------
# Dropdown-Menü
# -------------------------------------------------

buttons <- lapply(

  seq_along(gemeinden),

  function(i) {

    sichtbar <- rep(
      FALSE,
      length(gemeinden)
    )

    sichtbar[i] <- TRUE


    list(

      method =
        "update",

      args = list(

        list(
          visible =
            sichtbar
        ),

        list(

          title = list(
            text = paste0(
              "<b>",
              gemeinden[i],
              "</b>"
            ),
            x = 0,
            xanchor = "left"
          )
        )
      ),

      label =
        gemeinden[i]
    )
  }
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Dezente Linien für Änderungen der Datengrundlage
# -------------------------------------------------

basislinien <- lapply(

  c(
    1973,
    1987,
    2011,
    2022
  ),

  function(jahr) {

    list(

      type =
        "line",

      x0 =
        jahr,

      x1 =
        jahr,

      y0 =
        0,

      y1 =
        1,

      yref =
        "paper",

      line = list(
        color = "rgba(90,90,90,0.28)",
        width = 1,
        dash = "dot"
      )
    )
  }
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Layout
# -------------------------------------------------

p_gemeinden <- p |>

  layout(

    title = list(

      text =
        "<b>Nordhorn</b>",

      x =
        0,

      xanchor =
        "left",

      font = list(
        size = 20
      )
    ),


    xaxis = list(

      title =
        "",

      showgrid =
        FALSE,

      zeroline =
        FALSE,

      linecolor =
        "#D9D9D9",

      ticks =
        "outside"
    ),


    yaxis = list(

      title =
        "Population",

      gridcolor =
        "#E9ECEF",

        FALSE,

      linecolor =
        "#D9D9D9"
    ),

      FALSE,


    hovermode =
      "closest",

      align = "left"
    ),


    updatemenus = list(

      list(

        type =
          "dropdown",

        x =
          0,

        y =
          1.18,

        xanchor =
          "left",

        yanchor =
          "top",

        active =
          default_index - 1,

        buttons =
          buttons,

        direction =
          "down",

        showactive =
          TRUE
      )
    ),


    shapes =
      basislinien,


    plot_bgcolor =
      "white",

    paper_bgcolor =
      "white",


    margin = list(
      t = 115,

  ) |>

  config(

# -------------------------------------------------
# Responsive Verhalten für Smartphone / Tablet
# -------------------------------------------------

p_gemeinden <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_gemeinden,
  "
  function(el, x) {

    var menu =
      x.layout &&
      x.layout.updatemenus &&
      x.layout.updatemenus.length
        ? x.layout.updatemenus[0]
        : null;

    var buttons =
      menu && menu.buttons
        ? menu.buttons
        : [];

    var wrapper =
      document.createElement('div');

    wrapper.className =
      'mobile-plotly-select-wrap';

    var label =
      document.createElement('label');

    label.className =
      'mobile-plotly-select-label';

    label.textContent =
      'Select municipality';

    var select =
      document.createElement('select');

    select.className =
      'mobile-plotly-select';

    select.setAttribute(
      'aria-label',
      'Select municipality'
    );

    buttons.forEach(
      function(button, index) {

        var option =
          document.createElement('option');

        option.value =
          String(index);

        option.textContent =
          button.label;

        if (
          menu &&
          typeof menu.active === 'number' &&
          menu.active === index
        ) {
          option.selected = true;
        }

        select.appendChild(option);
      }
    );

    wrapper.appendChild(label);
    wrapper.appendChild(select);

    if (el.parentNode) {
      el.parentNode.insertBefore(
        wrapper,
        el
      );
    }


    function responsiveGemeinden() {

      var mobile =
        window.innerWidth <= 600;

      wrapper.style.display =
        mobile ? 'block' : 'none';

      var update = {

        'autosize': true,

        'margin.t': mobile ? 48 : 115,
        'margin.r': mobile ? 8 : 25,
        'margin.b': mobile ? 45 : 55,
        'margin.l': mobile ? 58 : 90,

        'title.font.size': mobile ? 16 : 20,

        'xaxis.tickmode': mobile ? 'array' : 'auto',

        'xaxis.tickvals': mobile
          ? [1821, 1950, 1973, 2000, 2026]
          : null,

        'xaxis.ticktext': mobile
          ? ['1821', '1950', '1973', '2000', '2026']
          : null,

        'xaxis.tickfont.size': mobile ? 10 : 12,
        'yaxis.tickfont.size': mobile ? 10 : 12,
        'yaxis.title.font.size': mobile ? 11 : 14,

        'hoverlabel.font.size': mobile ? 11 : 13,

        'updatemenus[0].visible': !mobile,

        'updatemenus[0].x': 0,
        'updatemenus[0].y': 1.18,
        'updatemenus[0].font.size': 12
      };

      Plotly.relayout(
        el,
        update
      );

      Plotly.Plots.resize(el);
    }


    select.addEventListener(
      'change',
      function() {

        var index =
          Number(select.value);

        var button =
          buttons[index];

        if (
          !button ||
          !button.args
        ) {
          return;
        }

        var traceUpdate =
          button.args[0] || {};

        var layoutUpdate =
          button.args[1] || {};

        Plotly.update(
          el,
          traceUpdate,
          layoutUpdate
        ).then(
          function() {
            responsiveGemeinden();
          }
        );
      }
    );


    responsiveGemeinden();

    window.addEventListener(
      'resize',
      responsiveGemeinden
    );
  }
  "
)
```

## Population change at municipality level

The map shows the percentage change in population between **2022 and 2025**. Both years are taken from the new annual LSN series and refer to the reference date of 30 June.

::: {.bevoelkerung-map-wrap}

```{r}
#| label: gemeindekarte
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Bevölkerungsdaten
#
# Dieselbe neue Gemeindereihe wie oben
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_map <- bevoelkerung_gemeinden


# -------------------------------------------------
# Gemeindegrenzen einlesen
# -------------------------------------------------

grafschaft_map <- st_read(
  "../data/grafschaft_gemeinden.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Bevölkerung 2022
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_2022 <- bev_map |>

  filter(
    year == 2022
  ) |>

  select(
    ags_8,
    population_2022 =
      population
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Bevölkerung 2025
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_2025 <- bev_map |>

  filter(
    year == 2025
  ) |>

  select(
    ags_8,
    region_name,
    population_2025 =
      population
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Jahre miteinander verbinden
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_vergleich <- bev_2025 |>

  left_join(
    bev_2022,
    by = "ags_8"
  ) |>

  mutate(

    veraenderung_abs =
      population_2025 -
        population_2022,

    veraenderung_prozent =
      100 * (
        population_2025 /
          population_2022 - 1
      )
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Mit amtlichen Gemeindegrenzen verbinden
# -------------------------------------------------

karte <- grafschaft_map |>

  left_join(
    bev_vergleich,
    by = c(
      "SCH_GEM" = "ags_8"
    )
  ) |>

  st_transform(4326)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Prüfen, ob alle 25 Gemeinden Daten haben
# -------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(
  nrow(karte) == 25,
  all(
    !is.na(
      karte$veraenderung_prozent
    )
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Symmetrische Farbskala um 0
# -------------------------------------------------

max_abs <- max(
  abs(
    karte$veraenderung_prozent
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


pal <- colorNumeric(

  palette = c(
    "#C62828",
    "#FDD835",
    "#2E7D32"
  ),

  domain = c(
    -max_abs,
    max_abs
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Separate Palette für die Legende
#
# Ziel:
# positive/grüne Werte oben,
# negative/rote Werte unten
# -------------------------------------------------

pal_legende <- colorNumeric(

  palette = c(
    "#2E7D32",
    "#FDD835",
    "#C62828"
  ),

  domain = c(
    -max_abs,
    max_abs
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Popup-Texte
# -------------------------------------------------

karte <- karte |>

  mutate(

    popup = paste0(

      "<strong>",
      BEZ_GEM,
      "</strong><br>",

      "Population 2022: ",
      format(
        population_2022,
        big.mark = ",",
        decimal.mark = "."
      ),

      "<br>",

      "Population 2025: ",
      format(
        population_2025,
        big.mark = ",",
        decimal.mark = "."
      ),

      "<br>",

      "Change: ",
      ifelse(
        veraenderung_abs > 0,
        "+",
        ""
      ),

      format(
        veraenderung_abs,
        big.mark = ",",
        decimal.mark = "."
      ),

      "<br>",

      "Change in %: ",
      ifelse(
        veraenderung_prozent > 0,
        "+",
        ""
      ),

      format(
        round(
          veraenderung_prozent,
          1
        ),
        decimal.mark = ".",
        nsmall = 1
      ),

      " %"
    )
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Kartenausschnitt
# -------------------------------------------------

bbox <- st_bbox(
  karte
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Karte
# -------------------------------------------------

leaflet(
  karte
) |>

  addProviderTiles(
    providers$OpenStreetMap.Mapnik
  ) |>

  addPolygons(

    fillColor =
      ~pal(
        veraenderung_prozent
      ),

    fillOpacity =
      0.8,

    color =
      "white",

    weight =
      1.5,

    popup =
      ~popup,

    label =
      ~BEZ_GEM,

    highlightOptions =
      highlightOptions(

        weight =
          3,

        color =
          "#333333",

        bringToFront =
          TRUE
      )
  ) |>

  addLegend(

    position =
      "bottomright",

    pal =
      pal_legende,

    values =
      ~veraenderung_prozent,

    labFormat =
      labelFormat(
        transform = function(x) -x
      ),

    title =
      "Change<br>2022–2025 (%)",

    opacity =
      0.9
  ) |>

  fitBounds(

    lng1 =
      unname(
        bbox["xmin"]
      ),

    lat1 =
      unname(
        bbox["ymin"]
      ),

    lng2 =
      unname(
        bbox["xmax"]
      ),

    lat2 =
      unname(
        bbox["ymax"]
      )
  )
```
